name: baoyu-compress-image
works_with: Claude Code, Codex and other skills hosts
short: Shrinks images to WebP or PNG and picks the best compression tool on your machine for you.
what: Point it at an image or a folder and it compresses to WebP by default, or PNG or JPEG, at quality 80 unless you say otherwise. It picks the first tool it finds in this order: sips, cwebp, ImageMagick, then Sharp. It reports the size before and after, like `245KB → 89KB, 64% reduction`.
who: Anyone who makes blog posts, sites or docs and wants smaller images without opening an editor. It is one of 20+ skills in the repo, and the author suggests installing only the ones you need.
needs: Node.js, with the ability to run `npx bun` (or Bun installed)

steps.title: Or as a Claude Code plugin
Compress a folder
steps.text: Add `--keep` to keep the originals, and `-f png` to stay in PNG.

watch: By default it replaces the original file. Use `--keep` if you want to keep it.
It can run `npx -y bun` to fetch Bun if you don't have it installed.
Defaults like format and quality can be set in an `EXTEND.md` file in the project or your home config folder.
